implicit_requested_intent: Create parametric lead sound with pluck character, modulation depth, and progressive effects chain

reasoning_chain.requested_intent: Initialize Serum 2 with default state ready for lead sound design
reasoning_chain.evidence: pe_001: Serum initialization confirmed; default preset loaded
reasoning_chain.rationale: Default preset provides known baseline for progressive configuration; allows tutorial to build sound incrementally

reasoning_chain.requested_intent: Establish primary tone source with harmonic brightness and unison thickness
reasoning_chain.evidence: pe_002: Saw waveform + phase distortion selected for OSC A
candidates: Saw wave (bright, rich harmonics) + phase distortion for grit
reasoning_chain.selected_decision: Saw wave + phase distortion on OSC A
reasoning_chain.rationale: Saw provides bright foundation suitable for lead; phase distortion adds harmonic texture without extreme nonlinearity. Transcript explicitly chose this path.

reasoning_chain.requested_intent: Layer secondary tone source at zero level, modulate silently for timbral variation
reasoning_chain.evidence: pe_003: OSC B saw wave at zero level confirmed
candidates: OSC B at zero (silent layer, modulated via envelope)
OSC B pitched differently for detuning
reasoning_chain.selected_decision: OSC B saw at zero level (modulation-ready)
reasoning_chain.rationale: Zero level preserves B as available modulation target via envelope 3; saw waveform matches A for harmonic alignment when modulated. Supports pluck effect.

reasoning_chain.requested_intent: Add organic, evolving modulation to OSC A via chaotic LFO
reasoning_chain.evidence: pe_004: Chaos Lorentz waveform + fine parameter X adjustment confirmed
reasoning_chain.selected_decision: Chaos Lorentz waveform, X axis modulation
reasoning_chain.rationale: Chaos Lorentz provides evolving but bounded modulation suitable for lead movement; elliptical phase space creates musical, non-repetitive variation. Fine parameter control targets X-axis dimension.

reasoning_chain.requested_intent: Add transient character to attack via white noise, shaped by envelope 3
reasoning_chain.evidence: pe_005: Noise oscillator at zero, Envelope 3 modulation confirmed
reasoning_chain.selected_decision: White noise at zero, modulated by Envelope 3
reasoning_chain.rationale: White noise at zero creates silent base; envelope 3 gates it on during attack phase only, adding click/presence without sustained noise. White preserves bright character.

reasoning_chain.requested_intent: Shape brightness and frequency content via filter, route OSC A only, modulate via envelope 2
reasoning_chain.evidence: pe_006: MG18 filter, OSC A routing only, Envelope 2 modulation confirmed
candidates: MG18 (12dB/oct resonant ladder) + OSC A only
Parallel routing of both OSC A and B
reasoning_chain.selected_decision: MG18 filter, OSC A only, Envelope 2 modulation
reasoning_chain.rationale: MG18 12dB ladder provides musical resonance suitable for lead; A-only routing ensures clarity (B remains silent carrier). Envelope 2 mod creates pluck effect via cutoff sweep.

reasoning_chain.requested_intent: Create pluck effect via fast cutoff sweep controlled by envelope 2 at full depth
reasoning_chain.evidence: pe_007: Envelope 2 at 100% modulation depth, ADSR tuned for pluck (low sustain, moderate decay, extended release)
reasoning_chain.selected_decision: Envelope 2 at 100% modulation depth, pluck ADSR
reasoning_chain.rationale: 100% depth ensures full dynamic range sweep for pronounced pluck; ADSR (sustain down, decay moderate, release up) creates percussive attack followed by smooth sustain tail. Resonance increased for articulation.

reasoning_chain.requested_intent: Modulate pitch via envelope 4 to intensify pluck attack with micro pitch variations
reasoning_chain.evidence: pe_008: Envelope 4 (sustain and decay at minimum) modulating global tuning confirmed
candidates: Envelope 4 tuning modulation (pitch variation on pluck)
reasoning_chain.rationale: Envelope 4 (sustain/decay down) creates fast pitch envelope synchronized to pluck; adds percussive character. Global tuning modulation affects both OSC A and B, creating coherent pitch drop.

reasoning_chain.requested_intent: Route signal through Bus 1 for convolver reverb to add space and smoothness
reasoning_chain.evidence: pe_009: Filter → Bus 1 routing, Convolver (Digital Hall 2) reverb confirmed
reasoning_chain.rationale: Convolver reverb using Digital Hall 2 impulse provides realistic room acoustics; Bus 1 routing allows independent mixing separate from main chain. Suitable for progressive/ambient aesthetic.

reasoning_chain.requested_intent: Add harmonic saturation and loudness presence via distortion overdrive
reasoning_chain.evidence: pe_010: Distortion overdrive with increased drive, reduced mix confirmed
reasoning_chain.selected_decision: Distortion overdrive with elevated drive, subtle mix
reasoning_chain.rationale: Overdrive provides smooth saturation suitable for lead character (not aggressive). Elevated drive increases perceived loudness while reduced mix maintains signal integrity. Adds musical harmonics.

reasoning_chain.requested_intent: Widen stereo image and add thickness via unison/dimension effect (7 voices)
reasoning_chain.evidence: pe_011: Hyper effect, 7 voices, dimension width, tune modulation confirmed
reasoning_chain.selected_decision: Hyper effect, 7 voices, dimension width control
reasoning_chain.rationale: 7 voices create perceived richness without overload; dimension width control adds space while tune modulation adds organic variation. Suitable for progressive lead aesthetic.

reasoning_chain.requested_intent: Shape frequency content via EQ and add spatial movement via ping-pong delay (1/16 note)
reasoning_chain.evidence: pe_012: Equalizer (mid-focused), Delay (ping-pong 1/16, reduced Q, increased feedback) confirmed
reasoning_chain.selected_decision: EQ (all-way up for presence) + Ping-pong delay (1/16 rhythmic sync)
reasoning_chain.rationale: EQ presence peak emphasizes mid frequencies for articulation; ping-pong 1/16 syncs with musical tempo, creating predictable spatial bounce. Increased feedback creates longer tail.

reasoning_chain.requested_intent: Glue final mix and prevent dynamics runaway with light compression, final gain makeup
reasoning_chain.evidence: pe_013: Compressor for dynamic control, final gain adjustment confirmed
candidates: Light compression + gain makeup (control without pumping)
reasoning_chain.rationale: Light compression prevents peaks while preserving transients; gain makeup restores perceived loudness. Provides safety without destroying pluck attack. Suitable for final mastering touch.

reasoning_chain.requested_intent: Final EQ stage via MG Ladder filter (between Hyper and EQ) with envelope 2 modulation for dynamic timbral control
reasoning_chain.evidence: pe_014: MG Ladder filter (miscellaneous/Serum filters), placement between Hyper and EQ, envelope 2 modulation confirmed
candidates: MG Ladder final filter (additional resonant sculpting)
reasoning_chain.selected_decision: MG Ladder filter placement (Hyper → MG Ladder → EQ), Envelope 2 modulation
reasoning_chain.rationale: MG Ladder final stage provides additional dynamic timbral control; placement after Hyper preserves width while before EQ allows EQ to shape the resonant peak. Envelope 2 modulation creates evolving brightness.

decision_summary.primary_design_intent: Parametric lead with pluck character, chaos modulation, space, and progressive effects
decision_summary.sound_design_philosophy: Bright, articulate lead (saw + phase dist) → pluck effect (envelope filter sweep) → organic modulation (chaos LFO) → space (reverb + delay) → loudness (distortion + compression)
decision_summary.effect_chain_architecture: Oscillators → LFO modulation → Filter (envelope driven) → Bus reverb + Main effects (distortion → hyper → EQ → final filter) → compressor → output
